name: Gujarat Energy Limited

profile.summary: Gujarat Energy Limited engages in the distribution of natural gas in India. It operates a network of approximately 42,600 kilometers of natural gas pipeline and 828 compressed natural gas (CNG) stations. The company supplies piped natural gas to approximately 22.6 lakh households, approximately 15,600 commercial customers; and approximately 4,400 industrial customers, as well as operates 828 CNG stations. The company also owns wind power generation assets in Gujarat and operates a pilot project of blending green hydrogen.
